artworks.title: Death of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, squared in black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a person lying in bed. The figures are robed and appear engaged. The drawing uses light and dark ink washes to create depth and dimension, highlighting the folds in the fabric of the robes and the expressions of the figures. The setting seems to be a room with architectural elements like columns. The incomplete circular shape suggests that this piece could be a draft or study for a larger work. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque periods.

artworks.title: Three Soldiers Discovering a Sleeping Woman
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with touches of red chalk, heightened with white, on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with warriors and figures in a natural setting. Two figures in armor and helmets are in the foreground, one holding a shield, facing each other. To the right, a reclining figure is on drapery, with another figure nearby. Trees and foliage are in the background. The lines are delicate and precise, typical of a preparatory sketch for classical themes.

artworks.title: Corner of a Wood (Coin d'un bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. George Matthew Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a view from under a canopy of large trees, with their trunks visible along the left-hand side. In the distance, there are gently rolling hills and lightly sketched trees. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture and depth, capturing the leaves of the trees and landscape details. The color palette is monochromatic with deep blacks and soft grays, with light and shadow enhancing forms. The land extends towards the horizon, meeting a softly rendered sky.

artworks.title: Three Figures Seated in a Meadow, Seen from the Back
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. William B. Jaffe
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals sitting side by side, facing away from the viewer. They are wearing wide-brimmed hats that cover their faces. Only the backs of their heads and upper bodies are visible. The background is textured and shaded, indicating an outdoor setting. The style of the drawing is sketch-like with soft, smudged lines.

artworks.title: A Fresh Breeze from the Sea
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Samuel Bogdonoff
artworks.description: The etching shows a person standing in a grassy or bushy landscape near a body of water. The individual is standing with a large brimmed hat held to their head with both hands, leaning slightly forward. Facial features are obscured by the hat. They have a light complexion, and their hair is tucked under the hat. The person wears a long coat that reaches below the knees and possibly a skirt or dress underneath. No jewelry is visible. The background includes a body of water to the right, birds in the sky, and clouds indicated by sketch lines.

artworks.title: Rough Sport in the Yosemite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Samuel Bogdonoff
artworks.description: An etching of horses in motion is depicted, with multiple horses engaged in a spirited chase across rugged terrain. The central horse is mid-gallop with its mane and tail streaming behind. Additional horses in the background contribute to the energetic movement. The artwork highlights the athleticism and vitality of the animals with sketchy, fluid lines capturing the moment of action in detail.

artworks.title: Figure of an Archer [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper; tracing marks on some of the outlines of the archer
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a slightly bent posture with their legs apart, drawing a bow. The individual is seen in a profile view with one arm extended forward holding the bow and the other drawn back. The person's face is partially obscured by the arm holding the bow string, but the visible profile shows a pointed nose and a smooth facial outline. The individual has long, wavy hair covered by a cap or headband. They are wearing a tunic-like garment with intricate patterns resembling scales or feathers on the shoulder and waist area, along with a fitted stocking or leg band on one leg. A quiver of arrows is attached to their back. The background is plain with light shading.

artworks.title: Rider and Standing Draped Man, after the Antique [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person standing in profile, facing right. The individual has a bald head and distinct facial features with a focused expression. They are wearing draped clothing with intricate detailing. The upper part of the image hints at a horse and rider. The image is monochromatic with a textured, neutral background.

artworks.title: Studies for Six Figures (sheet from a model book) [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray wash heightened with white on brown-gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four draped figures and some additional sketch lines. The image appears to be a study or preparatory sketch of figures practicing drapery and human form posing. Each of the figures is rendered with a focus on the folds and gradients of fabric as well as the stance or gesture of the figures, emphasizing the movement and placement of cloth. The figure on the top left is depicted as if caught in mid-step or action. The central figure is seated in a resting pose, hands together in front under a detailed cloak. The third figure, to the right, is also seated with rich cloth folds. The final two outlined figures at the bottom appear to be lying or reclined, one fully detailed while the other emphasizes garment layout. The use of shading and texture captures the realistic draping of the fabrics on the figures.

artworks.title: Forum Vulcani: The Hot Springs at Pozzuoli
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view looking down into a crater-like landscape with steep surrounding cliffs. The horizon is high in the image, obscured by rocky formations and rising plumes of smoke. The detailed drawing has a sketch-like quality with fine lines depicting the cliffs and swirling smoke. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and beige. Two figures and a horse stand on a sloped terrain, providing scale. The crater's basin is visible, with smoke plumes and rock formations in the distance, stretching towards the horizon.

artworks.title: The Drunken Silenus
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.3 × 35.1 cm (10 3/4 × 13 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with satyrs and a large wine vat. The scene shows a reclining figure surrounded by satyr-like creatures. One satyr is offering a cup, while another is drinking directly from the vat. A donkey's head on the right appears to be braying. The foreground includes grapevines and other mythical creatures. Details are finely etched in a classical style.

artworks.title: Two Peasants
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures wearing hats and holding walking sticks. The drawing shows two individuals in motion, with a focus on their attire and posture. They are wearing robes or cloaks, along with large hats shielding their faces. Their expressions convey movement or conversation, with one figure looking upward adjusting his hat, while the other looks sideways. The sketch is created with simple line work, giving texture to their clothing, emphasizing the folds and creases. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious gathering with animals and angels in a forest setting. The artwork is highly detailed, showcasing a large group of figures, including several animals such as horses and dogs, gathered in a richly wooded landscape. The scene is filled with intricate details, including cherub-like figures in the trees and skies above. The gathering seems to be centered around a central figure holding something significant, possibly a crown. The use of line work is meticulous, with cross-hatching and shading enhancing the depth and richness of the composition. The figures are rendered in a manner that reflects a historical or biblical narrative, with a mixture of expressions and gestures that bring a dynamic storytelling element to the scene.

artworks.title: In the Fields at Ennery (Dans les champs, a Ennery)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a pathway flanked by trees. The horizon is not visible as the path fades into a forested area. The brushstroke technique is sketch-like, depicting leaves, branches, and the pathway. The overall color palette is monochromatic with a soft sepia tone. The scene shows two figures walking along the path.

artworks.title: Market at Pontoise (Marché a Pontoise)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy marketplace scene. It depicts an array of figures closely gathered together, with most of them facing away or to the side. They appear to be engaged in conversation and examination of goods at a market. The composition is rich with a textured use of line and shading that suggests the presence of a lively environment filled with movement. The attire of the figures consists mostly of hats and long coats or shawls, giving the scene an old-fashioned quality. In the foreground, baskets and boxes can be detected. The drawing uses a monochrome palette, employing varying intensities of black and grey tones to create depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Beggar with a Crutch (Mendiant a la bequille)
artworks.medium: lithograph on blue-violet paper laid down on whitepaper
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking down a pathway. The person is wearing a heavy cloak, standing upright and leaning on two walking sticks. Their facial features are obscured as they face away from the viewer and wear a wide-brimmed hat. The person is accompanied by two children standing near trees, with one child holding a basket. In the background, there is dense foliage of trees and hedges, creating a natural, park-like atmosphere.

artworks.title: View of Pontoise (Vue de Pontoise)
artworks.description: The image shows a hilly landscape with small clustered houses and a church tower. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the image, separating the sky from the landscape. The sky has scattered clouds. The brushstrokes in the landscape are gestural and sketch-like. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of beige and soft brown. There is a field or open area with vegetation and paths in the foreground, and buildings on a slope in the distance.

artworks.title: Catalogo delle Opere
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring an intricate architectural and textual composition. The drawing includes a list of works or catalog of architectural interests, primarily in Rome, alongside artistic engravings depicting Roman scenes and ruins. The text blocks list Roman antiquities, different architectural pieces, and views of Rome. The engravings showcase classical motifs like Roman columns, urns, and structural facades. A notable element is an architectural illustration of St. Peter's Basilica in the bottom right corner, surrounded by emblems and Italian text. The drawing is likely a catalog or promotional work by Giobattista Piranesi, as indicated in bold at the top. The border of the drawing is densely detailed, enhancing the overall composition.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.description: The etching shows two central figures standing closely together. The woman on the left has tied back hair and a serene expression. She wears a flowing, layered attire. The woman on the right wears a layered garment with a headscarf, facing the first woman and appears to be holding her hand. Behind them is a man in a robe with tousled hair. Another figure is in the background to the left, among foliage, with indistinct facial features. The background shows a sky with clouds and part of a possible building. Tree branches extend into the sky from the edge of the image.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with the Goldfinch
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows five figures positioned before an arched background. At the center is a woman holding a young naked child on her lap. The woman has soft facial features with smiling lips and a calm demeanor. Her hair is partially covered with a cloth, and she wears a flowing garment. To her side, an older woman is visible from the neck up, wearing a hood or headdress. A man stands behind them, with slightly wavy hair and a beard, wearing a relaxed garment. Another child is partially visible, reaching towards the child held by the woman and holding an object resembling a small cross. The setting has a textured background with a tree on the left and an arched stone structure with vines or foliage at the top right.

artworks.title: Man Assisted by Faith, Hope and Charity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of allegorical figures and symbols. The image depicts four central figures each representing different virtues or concepts, such as Charity and Hope, which are labeled in the scene. The central figure holds a flame in hand, while another appears to gesture upward. Surrounding them are additional elements including children and symbolic items like an anchor and books. The scene is highly detailed, with carefully rendered folds in the clothing and expressive gestures enhancing the illustrative style. The composition incorporates classical elements, with an emphasis on human forms and balanced arrangement. Text elements are interspersed, adding a narrative or descriptive layer to the visual depiction.

artworks.title: The Marriage of Labor and Diligence
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of symbolic figures and a landscape. The image features several figures in classical attire, each holding objects or wearing attire that implies a symbolic meaning or narrative. On the left, a donkey is burdened with wooden sticks, accompanied by a figure with breasts visible. The word "Labor" is beneath the figure to its right. Next, there are two central figures engaged in an act that appears like a handshake or an agreement; one wears a distinctive hat, while the other wears a helmet. On the far right, a female figure in flowing robes holds an object that resembles a lyre, and the label "Deligentia" points to an abstract concept being personified. There is a mountainous landscape with a city built into its side in the background. The skies are filled with clouds, and there are inscriptions at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Diligent Worker Aspiring to the Rightousness of the Lord
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This image shows allegorical figures on a rocky path leading to a throne. The central figures are engaged in symbolic actions. On the left, a draped figure associated with "Spes" or hope pulls a rope tied to a canopy above. Two seated figures symbolizing justice and fortune sit under the canopy, one holding scales and the other holding a radiant sun-like object. Below them is a pathway arching over a cityscape, linking the figures on each side. On the right, two workers labeled "Labor" and "Fides" appear to be engaged in labor with a spade and gestures. The composition features intricate lines, detailed shading, and Latin inscriptions emphasizing hope, labor, and faith overcoming struggles towards justice and fortune.

artworks.title: The Lord Endowing the Diligent Worker with Food and Clothing
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of allegorical figures representing various human attributes and activities in a landscape scene. The composition shows four figures identified as 'Vetus,' 'Diligentia,' 'Amicus,' and 'Labor,' each accompanied by their respective symbols. 'Vetus' is holding a hoe, 'Diligentia' holds a clock and a sickle, 'Amicus' is carrying a sun disk or wheel, and 'Labor' has a shovel. The landscape includes cloud formations and a tree on the right, while a figure hovers in the clouds above. The figures wear flowing garments and the inscription at the bottom links the virtues to toil and reward.
